title: Relaxed and chilled.
text:
This was the first time my friends and I had ever been on a private boat just for ourselves, and we absolutely loved it! Our skipper was very welcoming and gave us clear instructions on how to stay safe throughout the trip.

Having drinks and snacks on board was perfect for such a hot day, and we were also provided with a speaker so we could play our own music, which made the experience even better.
